none: PAS LON-445BE3: Copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), Treveri mint (AD 330-333), Reece period 17.

Copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), Treveri mint (AD 330-333), Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTI-NVS MAX AVG]. Reverse description: Two soldiers and two standards. Reverse inscription: [GLOR]-IA EXERC-[ITVS]. Dimensions: diameter: 15.46mm; weight: 1.13g
